sentences.en: The institution of marriage appears to be on the decline.
sentences.zh: 婚姻制度似乎正在衰落。

sentences.en: Our city doesn't have enough public institutions for the aged.
sentences.zh: 我们城市缺乏足够的养老机构。

sentences.en: This has shaken my faith in the institutions of government.
sentences.zh: 这动摇了我对政府体制的信任。
